signatures.description: Implement a Byzantine-tolerant checkpoint repair coordinator for a sharded log where replicas may equivocate about both state roots and included configuration epochs, while messages can be delayed or replayed across view changes. Select a repair certificate that preserves safety under up to f Byzantine replicas, resumes from the newest admissible checkpoint, and avoids unbounded buffering when proofs arrive out of order.
